meta.description: A focused desktop workspace for building and testing Telegram Mini Apps. Version 2 is in development.

footer.independent: Independent open-source software. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Telegram.

home.title: TMA Studio — a workspace for Telegram Mini Apps
home.badge: A focused workspace for Telegram Mini Apps
home.lead: Bring your local app into a dedicated simulator. Explore users, launch modes and Telegram interactions without losing your development flow.
home.status: Version 2 in development · planned for Windows, macOS and Linux
home.mediaAlt: Design preview of a floating phone simulator with a compact toolbar above it
home.mediaCaption: Design preview from the version 2 design baseline (September 2026). It is not a capture of released software.
home.featureUsersBody: Mock identities, language, Premium and launch context in one reusable project.
home.featureInspectBody: Guest developer tools, deterministic protocol fixtures and clear capability reporting.
home.featureFocusBody: A floating device, a compact toolbar and the controls you need close at hand.
home.profilesList: Android · iOS · Telegram Desktop · macOS · Web A · Web K
home.profilesNote: Feature support will be published per profile. A simulator does not replace final testing in real Telegram clients.

download.title: Download
download.intro: Version 2 has not been released yet, so there are no installers to download.
download.notice: When a release is qualified, this page will list each operating system and architecture with its checksum and signature. Nothing here is detected from your browser.
download.sourceBody: Developers can build the version 2 source today. See Getting started for the exact commands.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.intro: These steps build the version 2 source. They do not produce a signed installer.
gettingStarted.requirementsBody: Bun 1.4.0 and a macOS, Windows or Linux desktop. The desktop runtime is currently qualified on macOS on Apple silicon; other platforms are still being verified.
gettingStarted.runBody: This starts the interface and the desktop host together.
gettingStarted.buildBody: This checks types and builds the interface. Platform packaging and signing are still in progress.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.intro: TMA Studio targets six Telegram client profiles. Each will report verified, simulated and unsupported capabilities separately.
compatibility.engineBody: Every profile renders Mini Apps with Chromium through CEF. Studio does not run Android, iOS or their native browser engines, so confirm engine-specific behavior on real devices.
compatibility.fontsBody: Studio's own interface uses Inter and Vazirmatn in every profile. This differs from some Telegram clients and never changes your Mini App's fonts.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.versionBody: In development. Release notes will be published here with the first qualified release.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.siteBody: This website is static. It loads no third-party scripts, fonts, analytics or trackers, and it sets no cookies.
privacy.appBody: Version 2 is designed to keep account sessions and bot tokens in the host process and protected system credential storage, separate from Mini App browser data. Simulated outcomes and real Telegram actions are separate modes. These requirements are being implemented and verified.
privacy.reportsBody: Never include bot tokens, Telegram sessions or unredacted launch data in issue reports.

support.title: Support
support.issuesBody: Open an issue in the GitHub repository. Describe your platform, app version, steps to reproduce and what you expected.
support.securityBody: Please report security problems privately to the maintainer through the contact listed on the GitHub repository, not in a public issue.
support.sponsorBody: Sponsorship would fund cross-platform testing, protocol maintenance, accessible interfaces and reliable releases. Sponsorship options will be listed here when they are available.
